entries.title: Starting Ferrous
entries.description: I'm just using this as a binder for my projects and blog.

entries.title: The improved page (more detail than notes give)
entries.description: Late yesterday and today I've turned Ferrous from an ugly static page, into something I can actually use. I added a CMS admin page so I don't have touch code every time I want to edit something, Projects, Journal, Tutorials, Links, and Guestbook are all editable now (only me can edit). I added an RSS Feed that auto updates (visit it in the top right corner of this page!), I added a guest book and suggestions form, guest book entry's will be sent to me then added to the site. Then finally I gave the page a new navigation bar and added a typewriter effect. I've put two days into this so I hope it works, and if it doesn't, suggestions is also for bugs, let me know.

entries.title: Site is indexed!
entries.description: Starting today you can look up terms such as "emdexium" and find this page. This is a huge milestone for Ferrous.
